# Works, Tune Directory, print books, Hutchinson, PDMX

(Moved from the root CLAUDE.md 2026-11-27.)

- Hooktheory and Real Book songs in the Tune Directory sheet (types `Hooktheory` 13,180 songs = priority tiers 1-2, `Real Book` 10,621 titles from `apps/realbooks/catalogue-data.js`; Genre column; ▶ YouTube / ♫ Spotify search / ♯ TheoryTab in the Open column): `python3 -I scripts/dir-songs/build.py` writes `apps/shared/data/dir-songs/{hooktheory,realbook}.json`, merging year / genre / composer from the caches that `python3 -I scripts/dir-songs/enrich.py [--set rb|ht]` fills from MusicBrainz (1 request a second, resumable, ~10 hours for everything; Real Book year = earliest recording found, not a publication date; Hooktheory composer = artist). Rerun build.py after enriching, then copy to `_site` / re-render.
- Tune Directory spreadsheet (#td-sheet, `apps/shared/works/td-sheet.js`; the page is the navbar tab "Tunes", in no sidebar, `page-layout: full`): every tune, theme, piece, score, song and unlinked MLT recording, columns filter (`>0` in number columns) and sort, any column hidden from "Columns" (localStorage `td-sheet-cols`); columns Composer / artist, Movement / part, Set / source, Kind (list). One link rule (header "LINK RULE"): title = the piece's home on the site, same tab (a Piece with none opens its details in the sheet), ⏱ = Timestamp Notes, ▸ = details (Works panel, concept uses, `from`), off-site = new tab ↗. Movements / themes / scores of one piece grouped under a "Work" row by composer + catalogue number, else title stem ("Group movements", localStorage `td-sheet-group`; rules in the header, `TdSheet.groups()`). Concepts list split at ";", grouped by source, labels cut at 48 characters. The grouped lists stay below. Every recording row on the site shows "bars marked" or not and opens in Timestamp Notes. Tests in `tests/works/works.cdp.js` (sheet checks) and `tests/lessons/ts-undo-hide.cdp.js`.
- Works: one entry per piece across the Tune Library, Classical Themes and analysed scores, with its recordings (YouTube, R2 path, or URL) and links: data `apps/shared/works/works-data.js` (format in its header), panel `works.js` (R2 bucket address: `WORKS_CONFIG.r2Base`, not set yet), page `practice/tune-directory.qmd`. `node scripts/works-suggest.mjs` lists likely overlaps. Downloaded datasets (most not yet on the site; CoCoPops and RS200 are on Pop Themes, `apps/themes/CLAUDE.md`): `~/Projects/corpora/README.md`; the Billboard SALAMI chords and the Isophonics Beatles chords (179 songs, ids 100001 up, `src: "iso"`, converted to the same SALAMI text by `scripts/isophonics-convert.mjs`, run from `node scripts/billboard-import.mjs`; bars from the beat files, metre read from the beat count, unverified) are in (Timestamp Notes `?salami=<id>`; Tune Directory sections #td-billboard / #td-isophonics, sheet types Billboard / Isophonics). Test `node tests/works/works.cdp.js`
- Suspect tunes (predicted bad ABC): `node scripts/tune-quality.mjs [--write] [--show <id|n>]` scores every tune in `apps/tunes/tunes-object.js` (key signature that does not fit the melody, chord scales that do not hold the melody, off-length bars, abcjs warnings, import junk like x rests / fingerings / unreadable chords, octave errors, unbalanced repeats, fragments, mismatched ties; weights in its header, no ground truth) and writes `apps/tunes/tune-quality.js` (`window.TUNE_QUALITY[id] = {s, r}`, score >= THRESHOLD). The Tune Library gives them the tag "suspect" and leaves them out (like needs-repair) unless the Tags filter asks or `crit.showSuspect`; the Tune Directory sheet has a "show suspect tunes" box (⚠ + reasons); the Tunes page About panel warns. Pages that use the library load `tune-quality.js` after `tunes-object.js`. Rerun after the collection changes. Test: the suspect check in `tests/works/works.cdp.js`.
- Print anthologies (pieces known from a book, with no notation or recording needed): `scripts/print-books/` (README in `cutler/`).
  Adding another book's indices (the user drops a scan in Downloads): follow `scripts/print-books/ADDING-A-BOOK.md` step by step.
  Tagg, *Everyday Tonality II* (2014): a second book, referenced by page (`PAGE_BOOKS` in build.py; `scripts/print-books/tagg/README.md`).
  Cutler, *Anthology of Music for Analysis* (Norton 2019): its two indices OCR'd from a scan (`cutler/ocr.txt`, `parse.py` + `fixes.py`
  + `combine.py` -> `cutler-index.json`, figures as chapter-figure). `python3 -I scripts/print-books/work-years.py [cutler|--themes|--works]`:
  years from Wikidata (API, cached; composer + catalogue number, `printlib.py`); `python3 -I scripts/print-books/build.py` writes the
  generated block `print-books:begin/end` in works-data.js (`in.print: [{book, fig, whole}]`, `in.theme` when a Classical Theme is the
  same piece, `composed`/`published`, merged into hand entries of the same id at load; also years for hand entries) and `cutler/figures.json`;
  then `node scripts/course-glossary.mjs` (glossary terms with `:CUTLER:` list the book's examples, sub-entries below). Tune Directory:
  section Print anthologies (#td-print), sheet columns Year and Print. Tests in `tests/works/works.cdp.js`, `tests/course/course.cdp.js`.
- Hutchinson excerpts: start/stop times, bars and which are notated on the site in `research_notes/hutchinson-clips.org` (`node scripts/works/hutchinson-clips.mjs`); plan for notating all of them, cheapest first, `research_notes/hutchinson-notation-plan.md`.
- Hutchinson clip notation: `node scripts/works/hutchinson-abc.mjs` writes `apps/shared/data/hutchinson/` (`index.json` + `<video>-<start>.abc`; kinds score-excerpt / score-source (piece on the site, bars not known) / chords (Billboard, `aligned:false`) / riff (`unverified:true`)). Sources per clip in its `SRC` table, bars only from its `BARS` table (page text or a listening check, never timing); bar check `scripts/works/hutchinson-abc-check.cjs`. Rerun hutchinson-clips.mjs after it. Test `node tests/works/hutchinson-abc.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail).
- Hutchinson book figures: `node scripts/works/hutchinson-figures.mjs` fetches the book source (github rhutchinson20/mt21c, GPL-3.0) to ~/.cache/mt21c, maps each figure to its clip (`research_notes/hutchinson-figures.json`) and makes PNGs (qlmanage; sips fails silently). 193 figures transcribed from the images by model to `apps/shared/data/hutchinson/fig/<video>-<start>.abc` (`%unsure` lines, `%bars ?` mostly; pitches unchecked); hutchinson-abc.mjs adds them as kind "figure", `unverified: true`, `barsOk` (2 false).
- PDMX scores in the Tune Directory (`scripts/pdmx/`): `extract.py` (picks from ~/Downloads/PDMX-piano / -quartet / -ensembles / -choir, part names read from each .mxl) → `verdicts.json` (original scoring or not, judged per score by a model from title / composer / parts: confidence report `research_notes/pdmx-originals.org`) → `node scripts/pdmx/convert-all.mjs --only originals` (convert.mjs + score-check on each; ABC to ~/Downloads/PDMX-abc) → `node scripts/pdmx/build.mjs` (sheet rows type "Score" from `apps/shared/data/pdmx/index.json`; passing scores copied to `apps/shared/data/full-scores/pdmx-<n>.abc`; what is left and why: `research_notes/pdmx-conversion.org`). Converter fixes for PDMX's repeated problems are listed in convert.mjs's header.
